_comment: WO-430 tiers + WO-432 tech-tree, perks re-authored to the owner's icon taxonomy (2026-06-20). Per building: tiers 1-4 (cost + cumulative GameModifiers + requiresVillageTier gate) + perks[] (Gold-cost research, unlocked AT a tier; iconId = a sprite in Resources/HudIcons/BuildingUpgrades/<iconId>.jpg; isSignature = the gilt T3 capstone). v4 (2026-07-02, perk-grid redo): every tier + perk carries a one-line concrete 'effect' string the panel renders on its tile (owner directive: player sees WHAT the enhancement does). v5 (2026-07-17, STRUCTURE-HP-per-tier, owner 'buildings don't change visually, they just unlock perks and maybe add more HP'): each tier carries a machine-readable 'structureHpBonusPct' (CUMULATIVE-ABSOLUTE fraction over the building's base max HP at that tier; owner-tunable) that the generic HP applier (ModifierService.StructureHpMultFor -> Building.ApplyStructureHpMultiplier) uses to raise the building's real max HP; the SAME value is ALSO appended to the tier 'effect' string as a plain 'Structure HP +N%' clause so the upgrade panel (BuildingUpgradeVM.EffectFor -> tier.Effect) shows it with no panel/VM edit. Owner mapping: Blacksmith = the armorer building; Barracks is a NEW building (troops); windmill keeps tiers, no perks. Icons are the existing <Building>_T1_<Perk> files. Mirror in StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical/. WO-861 (2026-08-02): the arcane-tower rows are now the CATHEDRAL OF MAGIC - Thrain's leveling building; its tier/perk modifiers were re-pointed from tower stats to MAGE stats + unlockSpell (see that building's _comment for the silently-dropped-key + tower-balance flags). WO-855 Phase 5 (2026-08-03, gather-faucet balance): the LUMBERMILL wood-production stack was the only production ladder breaching WO-855 section 4.8's 'cap stacked mults at +50-80% over base from perks alone'. ModifierService.Compute multiplies the CURRENT tier def by EVERY owned perk, so a maxed mill compounded tier T4 1.50 x perks 1.08 x 1.15 x 1.10 = x2.05 (+105%). Tier ladder rescaled 1.12/1.20/1.35/1.50 -> 1.10/1.18/1.28/1.40 and perks 1.08/1.15/1.10 -> 1.06/1.10/1.08, giving a max stack of 1.40 x 1.06 x 1.10 x 1.08 = x1.763 (+76.3%), inside the band. The 'effect' strings were rewritten in the same edit so the upgrade panel never advertises a percentage the modifier no longer grants. The other two production ladders were MEASURED and left alone: forge resourceEfficiencyMult maxes at 1.22 x 1.08 x 1.15 = x1.515 (+51.5%) and windmill foodProductionMult at x1.45 (+45%), both already inside the band. Guarded by BuildingUpgradeRegression case 7 [gather-faucet], which walks EVERY building's tier x perk product for every *ProductionMult / resourceEfficiencyMult key. v6 (2026-08-08, ladder-vs-nameplate name parity): the ladder row for id 'forge' read displayName 'Forge' while structures-catalog.json + buildings.json (canon-strings key 'forge') both resolve that SAME id to 'Armorer' - so one building read 'Forge' on the upgrade screen and 'Armorer' on its nameplate. Per WO-840 the naming is inverted on purpose: catalog id 'workshop' IS the weapons shop (displayName 'Forge'), catalog id 'forge' IS the armor shop (displayName 'Armorer'), and catalog id 'armorer' is the 'Blacksmith'. The LADDER was corrected to the nameplate, not the reverse. NOTE (unresolved, owner call): this ladder block's TIER names are still smelting flavor ('Ignite the Forge' / 'Improved Smelting' / 'Master Metallurgy' / 'Forgefire') under an 'Armorer' header - flavor text, deliberately left alone here.

buildings._comment: WO-861 A3 (owner-approved 2026-08-02) — this is THRAIN'S LEVELING BUILDING, not a defence. Its tier perks were re-pointed from TOWER stats (towerDamageMult / towerRangeMult / arcaneOverload) to MAGE stats + learnable SPELLS. Do NOT confuse it with the DEFENSIVE 'Arcane Spire' (tower_arcane_spire, behaviorId ArcaneTower) — Spire = defending, Cathedral = leveling. displayName now matches structures-catalog.json ('Cathedral of Magic'). NEW perk keys — mageSpellPowerMult / mageManaMax (ADDITIVE integer, not a mult) / mageManaRegenMult / mageHpBonusPct / mageShellStrengthMult / mageManaCostMult / unlockSpell (comma-separated abilities.json ids) — are LIVE as of WO-861 Phase 3 (re-verified 2026-08-02): GameModifiers carries every one of them, ModifierService.Apply aggregates them BY KIND (the four mults compound, mageManaMax + mageHpBonusPct add, unlockSpell UNIONS its comma list) and HeroTalentModifiers -> HeroAbilities consume them, so an authored value is felt rather than silently dropped. The earlier 'Newtonsoft SILENTLY DROPS these' note in this comment is SUPERSEDED and was stale. CUMULATIVE-ABSOLUTE IS LAW FOR EVERY TIER LADDER IN THIS FILE (defect found + fixed 2026-08-02): ModifierService.Compute applies ONLY BuildingTierCatalog.TierOf(id, currentTier) - ONE tier def, never a sum over the tiers beneath it - so EVERY tier must RESTATE the full kit of every tier below it, both keys AND unlockSpell ids. The union in Apply merges across CONTRIBUTORS (tier + perks + other buildings), NOT across tiers of the same building, so this cannot be fixed in code. Before the fix the mage rows were per-tier DELTAS: T2 dropped spellPower, T3 dropped mana+spellPower+frost-nova, and T4 dropped mana/hp/shell AND all three earlier spells - a fully-upgraded Cathedral was strictly WORSE than tier 3 (it traded Frost Nova + Manaweave + Arcane Bolt for Cataclysm). The tower keys were already authored correctly (T3 and T4 both restate towerDamageMult + towerRangeMult) and are the template. Guarded by CathedralCumulativeRegression [cathedral-cumulative], which enforces the rule for EVERY building in this file. BALANCE HOLE FOUND AND CLOSED (owner: 'fix the tower research ladder', 2026-08-02): re-pointing this building to mage stats left NOTHING in the entire catalog granting towerDamageMult / towerRangeMult / arcaneOverload, so every defensive tower silently lost its village-wide research buff. The tower keys are RESTORED here ALONGSIDE the mage keys - the Cathedral of Magic now powers BOTH Thrain AND the realm's arcane defences, which is thematically coherent and, more importantly, is the only place that actually WORKS: the tier ladder is consumed per building id, and only 6 buildings have blocks (arcane-tower, armorer, barracks, forge, lumbermill, windmill). tower_arcane_spire ('Arcane Spire', a real buildable Tower costing 80 crystals) has NO block, so authoring one there would have produced data with no consumer - the same silent-drop failure the mage keys have until Phase 3. NOTE the two ladders are independent: tower-perks.json is the PER-TOWER tier table (WO-432) every placed tower applies to itself and was never affected; these keys are the GLOBAL multiplier ArcaneTower.EffectiveDamage/EffectiveRange read off ModifierService.Active. Values restored verbatim from the pre-re-point ladder (T1 dmg 1.05 / T2 1.08 / T3 1.18+range 1.12 / T4 1.18+1.12+arcaneOverload).

buildings._comment: TROOP-upgrade track. Owner directive 2026-06-21: the PREMIUM/hardest building — 6 tiers (others have 4), costs well above every other building at each tier, troop mults escalating past everything else. Effects flow to DEPLOYED TROOPS automatically via ModifierService.Active.TroopDamageMult/TroopHealthMult -> TroopDeployer (no code needed). T1-T3 keep Gold-research perks (icons exist); T4-T6 are steep tier-only capstones. structureHpBonusPct escalates past the 4-tier buildings to match its premium identity (owner-tunable).
